## T-test (equal variance)

Двухвыборочный t-test со стандартной формулой (equal_var=True). Подходит для continuous метрики с примерно равной дисперсией в группах. Если дисперсии заметно отличаются — лучше Welch.

from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
import numpy as np

metric_col = '{{metric_column}}'
alpha = {{alpha}}

control = df[df['variant'] == 'control'][metric_col]
treatment = df[df['variant'] == 'treatment'][metric_col]

t_stat, p = ttest_ind(treatment, control, equal_var=True)

m_c, m_t = control.mean(), treatment.mean()
diff = m_t - m_c
se = np.sqrt(control.var(ddof=1) / len(control) + treatment.var(ddof=1) / len(treatment))
z_crit = 1.959963984540054 if alpha == 0.05 else __import__('scipy.stats', fromlist=['norm']).norm.ppf(1 - alpha / 2)
ci_lo, ci_hi = diff - z_crit * se, diff + z_crit * se
rel_lift = diff / m_c if m_c else float('nan')

print(f'control mean   = {m_c:.4f}')
print(f'treatment mean = {m_t:.4f}')
print(f'absolute diff  = {diff:+.4f}')
print(f'relative lift  = {rel_lift:+.2%}')
print(f't = {t_stat:.4f}, p = {p:.4f}')
print(f'CI {1 - alpha:.0%}: [{ci_lo:+.4f}, {ci_hi:+.4f}]')
print('SIGNIFICANT' if p < alpha else 'not significant')

# Canonical bindings (Sprint 7 ADR-015) — читается export-cell.
p_value = float(p)
ci_lower = float(ci_lo)
ci_upper = float(ci_hi)
delta_rel = float(rel_lift) * 100

# Точечный график эффекта: CI абсолютной разности vs 0 (Δrel в title).
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
if all(v is not None for v in (ci_lower, ci_upper, delta_rel, p_value)):
    center = (ci_lower + ci_upper) / 2
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3))
    ax.errorbar([center], [0], xerr=[[center - ci_lower], [ci_upper - center]],
                fmt='o', color='#a3e635', ecolor='#a3e635', capsize=10, markersize=12)
    ax.axvline(0, color='#f87171', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, alpha=0.7, label='No effect')
    ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.set_xlabel('Absolute effect (treatment − control)')
    ax.set_title(f'Δrel = {delta_rel:+.2f}%   CI95 (абс. разность) [{ci_lower:+.4f}, {ci_upper:+.4f}]   p = {p_value:.4f}')
    ax.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=False)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
